katie: starting canary. monitoring p95/err/allocs for 10m. i'm stepping out for lunch at +6m, @sanjay will own while i'm away :handshake:
sanjay: on call, watching dashboards -> https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/api-runtime. setting alert watch for errors >0.8%
deploy-bot: canary 5% -> success. metrics: p95 +2ms, errors +0.12%, mem usage stable. progressing to 25%
lisa: quick heads-up — i'm pinning model variant to `quantized-v2` in us-west-2 for this rollout to keep latency consistent
katie: ack. pin applied for prod/us-west-2. plan: unpin after 1h if stable. added note to changelog: "pin model variant for perf"
deploy-bot: rollout 25% -> WARNING: anomaly detected in /chat-stream. error rate spike to 1.8% for 3m (autocut threshold=1.0%). sample logs:
```
2026-03-20T15:12:03Z ERROR handler.go:142 request_id=aa2b: upstream 502 from model-server-7 oom
2026-03-20T15:12:04Z WARN serve: kv-cache miss increased
```
deploy-bot: initiating automatic rollback to previous tag `release/2026-03-19-v3.4.9` as per policy (error threshold exceeded) :rotating_light:
sanjay: confirm rollback. kicking rollback job now — will monitor until traffic stable
deploy-bot: rollback started · target=release/2026-03-19-v3.4.9 · commit=3b4a1d · draining canaries and shifting traffic
otto: seeing a surge of 502s in the canary pool, container OOMs on model-serving replicas. pushing a temporary change to the autoscaler min-replicas=3 to help drain gracefully
deploy-bot: rollback complete · traffic now 100% -> release/2026-03-19-v3.4.9 · status=rolled_back · duration=18m · postmortem=https://redwood/incidents/INC-2026-0319-deploy-spike
katie: thanks team. opening a short postmortem and adding a rollback note to the release notes. will revert the `quantized-v2` pin and run a staged test in staging. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-oncall
sanjay: staying on monitoring for 30m. will escalate if anything else pops up
deploy-bot: FYI: next attempt to redeploy should include a fix for OOM behavior or a reduced model batch size. see rollout checklist -> https://redwood/docs/deploy-checklist
katie: copy that. good rollback. closing this thread for now :white_check_mark:
